feature: Productivity features for desktop users
description: List and total filters, row copy and paste, keyboard shortcuts, improved navigation, and the Tell Me window support faster desktop work.

feature: Accessibility features for desktop users
description: Desktop accessibility improvements. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Refreshed experience on major desktop screens
description: A refreshed interface across role centers, lists, worksheets, documents, and detail pages in the browser and Windows 10 app.

feature: Business Central everywhere
description: Business Central became available for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployments, with the on-premises option succeeding Dynamics NAV.

feature: Combined mobile/companion app for Business Central
description: A unified mobile experience for accessing Business Central. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Enhanced Power BI embed experience
description: An improved embedded Power BI experience. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Permission sets are editable
description: Allows administrators to create or copy a permission set into an editable user-defined set. From a user card, the Effective Permissions page shows the permissions assigned to a user and the system or user-defined sets that grant them.

feature: Tenant administration for VARs
description: Partners can manage tenant health, troubleshooting, notifications, and sandboxes through the Business Central administration center.

feature: Improved Visual Studio Code AL experience
description: Improves extension development and troubleshooting with stronger breakpoint support, inline help, and event tracing for a user scenario. The release also adds extension support for enums, report datasets, and field groups, plus .NET interoperability for on-premises deployments.

feature: Localization apps and translation apps
description: Microsoft described a localization strategy combining Microsoft-led and partner-led models, including localization extensions.

feature: Intelligent edge for Dynamics GP, Dynamics SL, and Dynamics NAV
description: Replicate data from on-premises Dynamics solutions to the cloud using Intelligent Edge. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Non-Inventory item type
description: Use the Non-Inventory item type for items that do not require inventory tracking.

feature: Document line tracking
description: Shows documents related to a sales or purchase order line, including archived orders, shipments, receipts, invoices, and blanket orders. Users can open either a related line or its full document to trace how the order was processed.

feature: Improved report layouts
description: The October 2018 release improved the layout of 31 reports.

feature: Create Company assisted setup improvements
description: Extends the guided company-creation process with a user setup step and the option to skip accounting-period setup. This helps administrators choose which setup tasks to complete while creating a company.

feature: Named-user licensing scenarios in cumulative update 01
description: On-premises cumulative update 01 enabled additional named-user licensing scenarios and requires a new license supporting product line IDs 49, 74, 75, and 76.

feature: Quick Entry
description: Speeds up repetitive keyboard-based data entry by moving the Enter key through a configurable sequence of important editable fields instead of the normal tab order. Users can personalize which fields are included, and the path can expand collapsed sections when necessary.

feature: Focus mode
description: Expands the selected document line section to provide more room for reviewing or entering lines, while hiding the FactBox. Users can toggle the view using its button or Ctrl+Shift+F12 and apply advanced filters to the expanded lines.

feature: Page inspection
description: Helps users and support staff troubleshoot a page by showing the underlying page and table identifiers, field values, applied filters, and extensions affecting the page or table. Open it from the page or with Ctrl+Alt+F1 without leaving the current work.

feature: Improved search
description: Improves Tell Me search with alternative business terms and results for partner solutions in AppSource. For example, users can search for product to find the Items page; developers can define additional terms for pages and reports.

feature: Improved list scrolling
description: Improves the responsiveness of large lists by loading rows on demand, speeding up initial display and keyboard navigation. Users can scroll with the keyboard or scrollbar without stopping at a fetching-more-rows message.

feature: Longer name and description fields
description: Increases Name and Description fields from 50 to 100 characters across master data, documents, journals, and ledger entries. The unit-of-measure description limit also increases from 10 to 50 characters, allowing more descriptive business data.

feature: Physical inventory counting
description: Uses Physical Inventory Orders and related Physical Inventory Recordings to organize a count, distribute work, and capture quantities. This document-based process improves control over larger counts compared with relying on journals alone.

feature: Bulk import item pictures
description: Imports multiple item pictures together instead of adding them to cards one by one. Name each image after its item number, package the images in a ZIP file, and use the Import Item Pictures page to select and import them.

feature: Select multiple items on sales and purchase documents
description: Adds several items to a sales or purchase document in one operation through the Select Items line action. On sales documents, the Default Item Quantity setting can prefill the quantity for the selected items.

feature: Merge duplicate records
description: Combines duplicate customer, vendor, or contact records into one, helping clean up master data. The user compares the records and selects the values to retain; the MERGE DUPLICATES permission set is required.

feature: Enter dimensions on document lines
description: Makes configured shortcut dimensions available as fields on document and journal lines, in addition to the two global dimensions. Users can enter dimension values directly on a line without opening the separate Dimensions page.

feature: Cancel issued reminders and finance charge memos
description: Consente di annullare solleciti ed effetti di interessi gia emessi.

feature: Copy line descriptions to G/L entries when posting
description: Copia le descrizioni delle righe nei movimenti C/G durante la registrazione.

feature: Copy documents when some lines are blocked
description: Migliora Copia documento consentendo la gestione di righe bloccate.

feature: Add links to navigation menu
description: Consente di aggiungere collegamenti a pagine nel menu di navigazione del Role Center.

feature: Resize columns with fewer clicks
description: Semplifica il ridimensionamento delle colonne.

feature: Filter option fields by multiple values
description: Permette filtri multipli sui campi di tipo opzione.

feature: Save and personalize list views
description: Consente di salvare viste elenco filtrate e personalizzate.

feature: Enhancements to Excel integration
description: Migliora l integrazione Excel dal client web.

feature: Filter information in reports
description: Migliora i filtri nelle request page dei report.

feature: Multitasking across multiple pages
description: Permette di aprire piu pagine contemporaneamente nel browser.

feature: Customize a user profile without code
description: Permette di personalizzare profili utente senza sviluppo.

feature: AL-only application platform
description: La Base Application diventa extension AL; C/SIDE/C/AL viene dismesso per questa major.

feature: Add the Name 2 field to customer and vendor cards
description: Allows users to personalize customer and vendor cards and lists to show the Name 2 field. The additional field stores longer legal names and supports exporting them, which helps organizations whose names do not fit in a single field.

feature: Include job information in archived sales and purchase documents
description: Retains job-related information when sales or purchase quotes and orders are archived. This lets users review project information from earlier document versions as a quote or order changes during negotiations.

feature: Use VAT clauses on different document types
description: Allows a business to define different VAT clauses by document type, such as an invoice or credit memo. The appropriate exemption text can explain why a reduced or zero VAT rate is applied on each document.

feature: View item availability by unit of measure
description: Shows available item quantities by unit of measure from the item list or document lines. This helps order processors assess availability in the units customers request when agreeing on shipping dates.

feature: View the number of general journal lines
description: Displays a count of lines at the bottom of a general journal. Users importing large journals or opening balances can compare the count with the source, because a balanced journal alone does not prove that every line was imported.

feature: View customers' contact and document info on sales documents
description: Displays the customer reference and external document number on sales quotes, orders, invoices, credit memos, and associated reports. These references help staff find the correct sales document when a customer asks about their purchase order.

feature: Skip empty lines in the Account Schedule report
description: Offers a Skip Empty Lines option on the Account Schedule report request page. It removes lines without data from reports such as balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements to make the output easier to review.

feature: MICR fonts available in Business Central online
description: Provides MICR E13-B and CMC-7 fonts and security fonts in Business Central online production and sandbox environments. Custom check layouts that use these fonts can therefore be rendered online; developers need suitable local fonts when designing layouts.

feature: New events to unblock printer extensions in Business Central online
description: Provides events that let extensions register printers and react when a report is ready to print. Developers can define printer options such as paper trays and copies, then route generated documents to a cloud-printing provider.

feature: Sign-in attempt telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits telemetry for successful and failed sign-in attempts and company-opening operations, including failure reasons. Partners can analyze the data in Application Insights to identify access or permission problems and help customers troubleshoot them.

feature: Search for features in Role Explorer
description: Search for features in Role Explorer.

feature: Enable non-interactive printing
description: Enable non-interactive printing.

feature: Import profiles and UI customizations
description: Import profiles and UI customizations.

feature: Show parts hidden on pages
description: Show parts hidden on pages.

feature: Go to related records from list pages
description: Go to related records from list pages.

feature: Improve pages with multiple parts
description: Improve pages with multiple parts.

feature: Bookmark reports
description: Bookmark reports.

feature: Categorize data
description: Categorize data.

feature: Enter data more easily
description: Enter data more easily.

feature: Filter data and create views
description: Filter data and create views.

feature: Use resources in purchase documents
description: Use resources in purchase documents.

feature: Send the right documents to contacts
description: Send the right documents to contacts.

feature: Receive more goods than ordered
description: Receive more goods than ordered.

feature: Undo shipment or receipt lines for non-items
description: Undo shipment or receipt lines for non-items.

feature: Manage permissions with deeper insight
description: Manage permissions with deeper insight.

feature: View data sizes per table
description: View data sizes per table.

feature: Cancel sessions
description: Cancel sessions.

feature: Use AL interface objects
description: Use AL interface objects.

feature: Integrate with Common Data Service
description: Integrate with Common Data Service.

feature: Pages open faster
description: Caches page structure so frequently used pages can render while fresh data loads, without saving business data to the device. Update 16.3 extends the cache across sessions for supported pages.

feature: Company lifecycle telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits telemetry for company creation, copying, and deletion, including failure reasons. Partners can use the traces to monitor company lifecycle operations and investigate failures.

feature: Migrate data from Business Central 14.x on-premises to Business Central 15.x online
description: Uses the cloud migration extension to move data from an April 2019 on-premises installation to Business Central online without first performing an on-premises upgrade.

feature: Update error telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Reports exceptions from update codeunits with the codeunit, AL stack trace, and error message so partners can diagnose extension update failures.

feature: New URL parameter hides web client header
description: Adds the showHeader URL parameter so embedded or focused web-client scenarios can hide the Microsoft 365 header. Hiding the header also removes access to its actions, such as sign-out and the app launcher.

feature: Improved user experience to keep things from going wrong
description: Adds visual and contextual safeguards, including prominent document statuses, context-sensitive actions, and mandatory-field indicators, to help users spot problems before processing documents or journals.

feature: Installing AppSource apps updates in the Business Central administration center
description: Lets administrators discover and install Marketplace app updates from Manage Apps, review dependencies, and investigate installation problems; administration API support enables programmatic management.

feature: Extension lifecycle telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits success and failure signals for extension synchronization, installation, update, and uninstallation, including failure reasons. Update 17.1 adds extension-level telemetry support for ISVs.

feature: Client pageview telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Sends client page-view signals to Application Insights so administrators and partners can understand usage and investigate browser or client-side performance problems.

feature: Delete extension data
description: Adds an explicit Delete Extension Data option when uninstalling an extension, allowing administrators to remove the data owned by that extension after confirmation.

feature: Business Central in Microsoft Teams
description: Connects Business Central and Teams so users can share records as compact cards and view or act on details in a Teams conversation. Microsoft lists general availability of the Teams app in update 17.4.

feature: OAuth 2.0 for Outlook add-in deployment
description: Usa OAuth 2.0 per distribuire l add-in Outlook in modo piu sicuro.

feature: Database and file capacity management
description: Mostra capacita database/file e relativo consumo nell Admin Center.

feature: Unlimited additional production environments
description: Permette di acquistare ambienti di produzione aggiuntivi con sandbox associate.

feature: Service-to-service authentication for Automation APIs
description: Supporta OAuth client credentials per servizi esterni che chiamano Automation APIs.

feature: Feature Management data update scheduling
description: Consente di pianificare aggiornamenti dati per feature abilitate da Feature Management.

feature: Faster low-level code calculation
description: Ottimizza il calcolo dei low-level code nella supply chain.

feature: Enhanced email capabilities
description: Improves email communication with support for multiple accounts, distribution groups, and attachment management, enabling businesses to send documents through modern email providers.

feature: Notify users of high-risk changes in selected setup fields
description: Lets administrators identify business-critical fields to monitor and notify users when their values change, helping detect sensitive setup changes.

feature: Use new sales pricing experience
description: Provides administration and user experiences built on the extensible price calculation engine, including tools to review the price calculation methods available in an environment.

feature: Control how Account Schedules for core financial reports are generated
description: Lets users choose whether to preserve existing account schedules and create new ones, or overwrite existing schedules when G/L account categories and financial reports change.

feature: Improved VAT Registration no. lookup
description: Uses the VIES service to validate VAT registration numbers and, where supported by national authorities, related company information such as addresses.

feature: Use environmentType and environmentName launch.json properties instead of obsoleted sandboxName
description: Updates AL launch configuration to identify the target environment using environment type and name instead of the deprecated sandboxName setting.

feature: Application Performance Improvements
description: Moves calculations for selected customer and vendor statistics FactBoxes to background tasks to reduce page loading time.

feature: Signal from job queue execution added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits signals when job queue entries are enqueued, started, completed, stopped, or cancelled, helping administrators monitor background jobs and investigate failures.

feature: Signal from permission changes to added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits telemetry for changes to permission sets and their assignments, including user-defined sets and changes made by extensions.

feature: Signal from the retention policy feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits events for retention-policy configuration and data deletion so partners and customers can monitor use of retention policies.

feature: Signal from the sensitive field audit feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits monitoring events for sensitive business fields, enabling partners to analyze changes to information such as bank details after field monitoring is configured.

feature: Signal from the email feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits email telemetry for successful and failed sending, helping administrators investigate email delivery problems.

feature: Signal from application packages lifecycle added to Application Insights Telemetry for partners
description: Emits lifecycle telemetry for configuration package operations such as import, export, application, and deletion.

feature: Snapshot Debugging
description: Records server-side AL execution as a snapshot that developers can inspect later in Visual Studio Code, including production-cloud scenarios supported from update 17.2.

feature: Restoring an Environment in the Admin Center
description: Allows an administrator to restore an environment to a point within the applicable backup retention period to recover from data corruption or deletion.

feature: Use Shortcut dimensions in G/L Entries for Financial reporting
description: Makes configured shortcut dimensions available on entry pages so users can filter financial information by values such as area and export those columns for analysis.

feature: Signal from web service key authentication added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits telemetry for successful and failed web-service access-key authentication. Microsoft subsequently deprecated and stopped supporting access keys for Business Central online; use OAuth for current online integrations.

feature: Handle Price List Exceptions with Allow Updating Defaults
description: Allows selected defaults such as currency and effective dates to be changed on individual price-list lines, supporting exceptions to the list-wide values.

feature: Use recurring journals to allocate balances by dimension values
description: Adds recurring journal methods and dimension filters that allocate costs using G/L account balances for selected dimension values.

feature: Correct dimensions on G/L entries
description: Consente di correggere dimensioni su movimenti C/G gia registrati mantenendo audit delle modifiche.

feature: Automatic item tracking cards
description: Crea automaticamente schede informative per lotti e numeri seriali.

feature: Bank reconciliation improvements
description: Migliora regole, report e visibilita della riconciliazione bancaria.

feature: Default bins for jobs
description: Propone ubicazioni/bin predefiniti su righe commessa e registrazioni.

feature: Define lot sizes for production stages
description: Aumenta il controllo sulle dimensioni lotto nelle fasi produttive.

feature: Navigate from non-editable fields to related records
description: Rende cliccabili campi correlati per aprire rapidamente il record collegato.

feature: Double-click records in lists
description: Il doppio clic apre il record selezionato nelle liste.

feature: Dimension issues detection and repair tool
description: Detects incorrect shortcut dimension numbers in dimension-set entries, such as values introduced by imports without validation, and helps repair problems that affect reports and page values.

feature: Integration of Word templates
description: Lets users add Word templates to interactions and log the resulting interactions to a segmented audience, using Business Central as the mail-merge data source.

feature: Data administration and cleanup tasks page
description: Brings administrative options for managing table and database size into one page and provides in-product guidance for cleanup tasks.

feature: Get report (raw data) into Excel from request page
description: Adds a data-only Excel output on the report request page, exporting the report dataset without applying its presentation layout.

feature: Export any list part to Excel
description: Extends Excel export to supported list parts so users can take visible list data into a workbook for further analysis.

feature: Upgrade to certificate-based Service-to-service (S2S) authentication for Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Integration
description: Supports moving Business Central online integrations with Dataverse from client-secret-based service authentication to certificate-based authentication.

feature: Extension validation on upgrade
description: Validates per-tenant extensions before an upgrade, checking dependencies, compilation, breaking schema changes, and duplicate object IDs so upgrades can proceed only after validation succeeds.

feature: Additional columns through personalization
description: Rende disponibili piu campi da aggiungere alle pagine tramite personalizzazione.

feature: Non-inventory items in requisition and planning worksheets
description: Uniforma l approvvigionamento di articoli inventariabili e non inventariabili.

feature: Bank and payment reconciliation improvements
description: Aggiunge preview posting e migliora matching e filtri delle riconciliazioni.

feature: Share Business Central record to Teams
description: Condivide dal web client un record direttamente in Teams.

feature: Excel actions moved to Share menu
description: Rende piu accessibili Open in Excel ed Edit in Excel.

feature: Copy environment to sandbox
description: Migliora la copia degli ambienti verso sandbox.

feature: Bulk couple Business Central and Dataverse records
description: Accoppia e sincronizza record con Dataverse in batch.

feature: Snapshot debugger performance metrics
description: Aggiunge metriche e dettagli di esecuzione durante il replay degli snapshot.

feature: Copying environments of different types
description: Extends environment copying to production-to-production, sandbox-to-sandbox, and sandbox-to-production scenarios, giving administrators more flexibility for implementation, testing, and maintenance.

feature: Operations log enhancements
description: Expands the Business Central admin center operations log with additional environment and app-management events, giving administrators a broader view of administrative activity.

feature: Restart environments
description: Adds an action on the admin center Manage sessions page to restart a Business Central environment as a troubleshooting step.

feature: Support for 2D barcodes
description: Provides fonts for two-dimensional barcodes in online production and sandbox environments and an AL module that helps developers encode supported barcode symbologies.

feature: Shipping agent information is copied from sales orders to warehouse shipments
description: Copies the external document number, shipping agent code, and shipping agent service code from a sales order when a warehouse shipment is created from it.

feature: AL compiler diagnostic messages includes URLs
description: Adds links from AL compiler and analyzer diagnostic messages to documentation about the issue and possible ways to resolve it.

feature: Blocking deletion of G/L accounts
description: Blocking deletion of G/L accounts.

feature: Auto-accept transactions for intercompany journals
description: Auto-accept transactions for intercompany journals.

feature: Payment reconciliation journal - Preview Posting enabled
description: Payment reconciliation journal - Preview Posting enabled.

feature: Allow sell-to and bill-to customers to be different for jobs
description: Allow sell-to and bill-to customers to be different for jobs.

feature: Bank Account Statement report
description: Bank Account Statement report.

feature: Block VAT and General Posting Setups
description: Block VAT and General Posting Setups.

feature: Change default company bank account on sales and service documents
description: Change default company bank account on sales and service documents.

feature: Check documents and journals while you work
description: Check documents and journals while you work.

feature: Consolidate customer and vendor balances
description: Consolidate customer and vendor balances.

feature: Finding documents and entries efficiently
description: Finding documents and entries efficiently.

feature: Fixed Quantity in production bills of materials
description: Fixed Quantity in production bills of materials.

feature: Add action on card and list pages to trigger a chosen flow from Business Central web client
description: Adds an Automate action group to eligible pages so users can run an instant Power Automate flow for the current record, such as a customer or sales order.

feature: Power Platform and Azure Logic Apps connector for Business Central online no longer in preview
description: Makes the online connector generally available with improved reliability, filtering, sorting, and support for related records such as document headers and lines.

feature: Fraud prevention headers for clients in the UK
description: Adds the fraud-prevention headers required by HMRC to electronic VAT submissions for Making Tax Digital in the United Kingdom.

feature: Release and reopen multiple documents
description: Allows users to release or reopen multiple documents together and shows a confirmation indicating the selected documents and those left unchanged.

feature: Improved settings for managing updates
description: Improves Business Central online update scheduling with a default update window and the ability to specify an environment time zone.

feature: Support inventory pick and warehouse pick operations for jobs
description: Supports inventory and warehouse picks for job-related item consumption, adapting the process to the location's warehouse configuration.

feature: Shopify prospects get a great first-run experience
description: Uses signup context to tailor the initial Business Central experience for Shopify prospects and help them explore onboarding without immediate partner assistance.

feature: Modern action bar
description: Riorganizza le azioni, introduce Home tab, split buttons e piu personalizzazione.

feature: Run app setup from Extension Management
description: Consente di avviare la configurazione di una app dalla gestione estensioni.

feature: Shopify connector improvements
description: Migliora UI, sincronizzazione e gestione del connettore Shopify.

feature: Excel reporting improvements
description: Espande l uso di Excel come layout e strumento di reporting.

feature: Improved Microsoft 365 collaboration
description: Aumenta integrazione con Teams, Outlook ed Excel.

feature: Access Business Central with your Microsoft 365 license
description: Allows eligible Microsoft 365 users without a Business Central license to read permitted Business Central data in a simplified Teams interface; this access does not grant rights to create, edit, or delete records.

feature: Embed Business Central in Teams tabs
description: Lets users pin a Business Central card or add a Teams tab containing a Business Central page or record, making relevant business data accessible within a chat or channel.

feature: Auto-Save as you work:
description: Saves individual field changes when the user moves focus away instead of waiting for the page to close. Microsoft notes that administrators may need to enable the feature in Feature Management.

feature: Accessibility declaration for Italy available
description: Adds an Italian accessibility declaration link to the help pane when the web client uses Italian and provides a corresponding link in the mobile app listing.

feature: Use SharePoint Connector module in System Application to build integration between Business Central and Sharepoint
description: Provides an AL module for connecting and authenticating to SharePoint and performing basic operations on files, folders, lists, list items, and attachments through SharePoint REST APIs.

feature: Use multiline text fields with Word mail merge
description: Preserves line breaks from multiline fields when Business Central data is merged into Word templates used to generate communications.

feature: Sync users based on environments security group
description: Limits the Update Users from Microsoft 365 action to licensed users in the security group assigned to the Business Central environment.

feature: Use default attachments in email sent from Business Central
description: Lets administrators assign files to email scenarios and mark them as default attachments so relevant files can be included when messages are composed.

feature: Easily comply with email sending limits through email throttling
description: Lets administrators configure a per-minute sending limit for an email account, helping outgoing messages respect provider rate limits.

feature: Move custom fields to extensions during cloud migration
description: Uses migration table mapping to move selected fields from an on-premises source table to a different online table or table extension during cloud migration.

feature: Integrated session using Service-to-Service (S2S) authentication can now schedule tasks
description: Allows supported integrated sessions authenticated with service-to-service credentials to schedule tasks without an interactive user.

feature: Media/image support for Business Central connectors
description: Enables Power Platform and Logic Apps connector scenarios that read or manipulate media such as item or customer images from Business Central online.

feature: Power Apps and Power Automate support for document attachments
description: Enables connector-based apps and flows to work with attachments and related record media, such as a PDF linked to a sales order or a picture linked to an item.

feature: Reverse payment reconciliation journal entries
description: Improves payment reconciliation workflows by supporting reversal of journal entries and helping users identify and avoid already posted entries.

feature: Access attachments on additional list pages
description: Adds the Attachments FactBox to additional list pages, including fixed assets, employees, items, resources, vendors, and selected posted documents.

feature: Scroll through more records in lists
description: Reduces the memory footprint of loaded records so users can scroll through more rows on lists and worksheets, subject to the available client resources.

feature: Copying the SystemID and data audit fields using CopyRows
description: Adds support for copying SystemId and data audit fields when transferring rows with the AL DataTransfer CopyRows operation.

productArea: Adapt faster with Microsoft Power Platform
feature: Turn off event-based sync for specific integration table mappings
description: Lets administrators enable or disable automatic event-driven synchronization for individual Dataverse integration table mappings, reducing synchronization load when many coupled records change frequently.

feature: Save time with automatic account codes
description: Uses customized posting groups to automate recurring journal, sales, or purchase postings and allocations across accounts or dimensions.

feature: Swedish localization delivered as extension
description: Delivers the Swedish localization as an extension and provides a data upgrade path from the previous localization.

feature: Attach AL debugger to active session or next session
description: Lets developers attach the AL debugger to a running session or the next session for a specified user using launch configuration identifiers and appropriate permissions.

feature: Non-deductible, partly deductible VAT expands functionality
description: Supports configuring and calculating fully or partially non-deductible VAT on purchases, including percentage-based deductions and related G/L posting setup.

feature: Partners can control welcome banner texts
description: Lets partners tailor the welcome banner and call to action shown when a user first signs in to a new company.

feature: Measure onboarding time of customers, apps and features
description: Emits onboarding telemetry based on business-process activity so partners can assess customer progress and provide assistance when onboarding stalls.

feature: Get unblocked using actionable error messages in select application areas
description: Improves error explanations and provides actions or links that help users navigate to the setup needed to resolve common problems.

feature: Synchronize returns, refunds from Shopify
description: Imports returns and refunds recorded in Shopify into Business Central as part of order synchronization.

feature: Additional types of document approval templates for Power Automate
description: Adds support for selecting approval workflow templates for more document types, helping Business Central online users configure Power Automate approvals.

feature: Connect to Dataverse when Business Central local currency is different from Dataverse base transaction currency
description: Permits a Dataverse connection when its base currency differs from the Business Central local currency, provided the Dataverse currency is configured in Business Central with an exchange rate.

feature: Use attachments from document lines while sending emails
description: Lets users add files attached to document lines to an email through the source document attachment selection in the email editor.

feature: Extend general ledger posting aggregations
description: Improves extensibility of G/L posting aggregation so localizations and partner solutions can alter how posting entries are grouped without changing the original buffer table key.

feature: Get control over how to view Power BI embedded content
description: Get control over how to view Power BI embedded content.

description: Consolidated Power Automate flow creation from Business Central templates.

feature: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Dataverse
description: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Dataverse.

feature: Enable specific virtual tables when connecting to Dataverse
description: Enable specific virtual tables when connecting to Dataverse.

feature: Create Power Automate flows supporting different companies
description: Create Power Automate flows supporting different companies.

feature: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables
description: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables.

feature: Use synthetic relationships to expose more Business Central data in Dataverse
description: Use synthetic relationships to expose more Business Central data in Dataverse.

feature: Business events in Business Central connector for Power Automate
description: Business events in Business Central connector for Power Automate.

feature: Bank reconciliation with Copilot
description: Bank reconciliation with Copilot.

feature: Search data from anywhere in Business Central
description: Search data from anywhere in Business Central.

description: AL Explorer.

feature: SecretText data type
description: SecretText data type.

feature: Allocation account type
description: Allocation account type.

feature: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Microsoft Dataverse
description: Exposes Business Central tables through Dataverse virtual tables so Power Platform apps and flows can work with Business Central data and relate it to native Dataverse tables.

feature: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables on Dataverse
description: Allows external Power Pages users to work with selected Business Central data through Dataverse virtual tables, with administrators controlling the permitted tables and operations.

feature: Include or exclude tables from cloud migration
description: Lets migration administrators select eligible tables to include or exclude when moving data to Business Central online, tailoring the scope to their requirements.

feature: Use actions to go to or fix errors inline
description: Adds actions to validation dialogs that can navigate users to the relevant setup or help resolve a problem directly.

feature: Improved data upgrade troubleshooting for Dynamics GP migration
description: Summarizes companies with upgrade failures and lets administrators drill into the record that caused a migration error.

feature: Easily integrate generative AI with your AL solutions
description: Provides Copilot development tools including the System.AI namespace and PromptDialog page type to connect AL solutions to Azure OpenAI and build consistent AI interactions.

feature: VAT posting in General Ledger setup
description: Separates the permitted VAT date range from posting date restrictions, enabling administrators to control VAT dates independently of general ledger posting periods.

feature: E-invoicing with NemHandel in Denmark
description: Adds an e-invoicing app for Denmark that supports OIOUBL and PEPPOL formats and connects to NemHandel through certified access points.

feature: Detect invalid cloud migration configurations with proactive warnings
description: Warns administrators about potential migration issues such as unused table mappings or differences between source and destination record counts.

feature: Translatable Excel layouts
description: Allows Excel report layout authors to use translation tags for worksheet names, chart headers, pivot elements, slicers, and shared strings, which Business Central replaces when rendering.

feature: Make use of static and runtime metadata available in Excel layouts
description: Provides hidden worksheets containing report metadata, request options, filters, and captions so Excel layouts can use contextual information without requiring it in the report dataset.

feature: Generic Microsoft Graph API Wrapper
description: Provides an AL Microsoft Graph module for authorization and client initialization and for issuing supported Graph API requests.

feature: Add Azure File Services API module
description: Provides AL procedures using the Azure Files REST API to manage cloud file shares and related directories and files.

feature: Marketplace app hotfixes are now validated against the latest available app version
description: Validates a Marketplace app hotfix against the latest app version targeting the next Business Central release to help detect breaking changes.

feature: Marketplace ISV publishers can preview their Marketplace apps with select customers
description: Lets publishers provide a preview app link and code so selected customers can install and test an app in sandbox environments before general release.

feature: Chat with Copilot
description: The legacy chat experience lets users ask natural-language questions to find Business Central data and get help with business tasks. Update 25.3 expanded its public preview to more countries and regions. Microsoft Copilot in Business Central replaces this legacy experience starting in version 29.

feature: Bank reconciliation assist with Copilot
description: Migliora l abbinamento delle transazioni bancarie con assistenza generativa.

feature: Create product information with Copilot
description: Genera descrizioni e informazioni articolo con Copilot.

feature: Improved project invoicing
description: Semplifica la fatturazione di progetto e scenari con piu progetti.

feature: Archive and restore projects
description: Permette archiviazione e ripristino di progetti.

feature: Assemble-to-project
description: Integra ordini di assemblaggio con righe pianificazione progetto.

feature: Sustainability journals
description: Introduce registrazioni e tracciamento dati di sostenibilita.

feature: Drag and drop multiple files
description: Consente di allegare piu file ai record con drag and drop.

feature: Power BI dashboards for core ERP
description: Amplia dashboard Power BI integrate per scenari ERP.

feature: Use linked environment in Dataverse integration
description: Uses the Dataverse environment linked in the Business Central admin center to simplify and secure setup of integrations with Dataverse and related Dynamics 365 apps.

feature: Simplify collections with Copilot for Finance and Business Central (preview)
description: Integrates Business Central with Copilot for Finance to help collections teams work with customer receivables and improve collection workflows.

feature: Install Field Service Integration with Business Central from Marketplace
description: Adds an optional installation step for the Field Service Integration app in the Dynamics 365 Sales integration setup, avoiding disruption for customers who do not use Field Service.

feature: Auto-apply templates when synchronizing data with Dataverse
description: Auto-apply templates when synchronizing data with Dataverse.

feature: Allow more than one user to post warehouse entries at a time
description: Allow more than one user to post warehouse entries at a time.

feature: Use new reports and demo data for financial reporting
description: Use new reports and demo data for financial reporting.

feature: Stay current with Shopify connector
description: Stay current with Shopify connector.

feature: Manage subscription billing and revenue and expense recognition
description: Manage subscription billing and revenue and expense recognition.

feature: Add an item as a Shopify variant
description: Add an item as a Shopify variant.

feature: Archive service management documents
description: Archive service management documents.

feature: Use Excel reports for consolidation and fixed assets
description: Use Excel reports for consolidation and fixed assets.

feature: Synchronize product translations to Shopify
description: Synchronize product translations to Shopify.

feature: Use specific prices and discounts when synchronizing prices in Shopify
description: Use specific prices and discounts when synchronizing prices in Shopify.

feature: Define shipping information for Shopify shipping fees
description: Define shipping information for Shopify shipping fees.

feature: Add extended text to project planning lines
description: Add extended text to project planning lines.

feature: Export posted sales invoices to Shopify
description: Export posted sales invoices to Shopify.

feature: Change the data search method in lists (general availability)
description: Lets users switch between searching across all columns and an optimized full-text search on supported list pages, subject to the relevant Feature Management setting.

feature: Report sustainability entries with financial reports (general availability)
description: Adds sustainability account totaling to financial reports, allowing emissions and fees to be combined with general ledger or statistical account values.

feature: VAT Return feature now available - Czechia (general availability)
description: Enables the standard VAT Return feature in the Czech localization to generate returns from VAT statement settings for submission to the Moje daně portal.

feature: Do ad hoc analysis on fixed assets, projects, and services (general availability)
description: Adds ready-made queries to support ad hoc analysis of fixed assets, projects, and service management data.

feature: E-file IRS 1099 forms without integration
description: Provides a 1099 FIRE magnetic-media report for preparing electronic returns that can be uploaded manually to the IRS FIRE platform, including on-premises scenarios.

feature: Migrate to the cloud from Dynamics SL (general availability)
description: Provides a supported migration path and tooling to move eligible data from an on-premises Dynamics SL installation to Business Central online.

feature: Start using E-Documents framework localized for Germany
description: Introduces German-localized electronic document handling for Peppol BIS3 and XRechnung invoices, with service-provider, manual upload, and email exchange options.

feature: Use the e-documents framework in the Spanish version
description: Localizes the electronic document framework for Spain, supporting globally available Peppol BIS3 and the Spanish FacturaE invoice format.

feature: Improvements to the Copilot & AI capabilities page
description: Updates the administrative page with revised guidance and a link explaining Azure OpenAI data processing for Business Central.

feature: Nested App Authentication for the Outlook add-in
description: Switches the Outlook add-in to Nested App Authentication. Microsoft notes that online customers need no action, while on-premises administrators must update the add-in setup.

feature: Package resources in extensions and access from AL
description: Lets developers include resource folders in an extension package and access the files from AL, for uses such as setup packages, demo data, and templates.

feature: Integrate Field Service with service management
description: Integrate Field Service with service management.

feature: View item availability in Field Service work orders
description: View item availability in Field Service work orders.

feature: Edit price lists in Excel
description: Edit price lists in Excel.

feature: Use SecretText with control add-ins and JSON objects
description: Use SecretText with control add-ins and JSON objects.

feature: Use improved troubleshooting options for cost adjustments
description: Use improved troubleshooting options for cost adjustments.

feature: Chat with Copilot to learn installed add-on apps
description: Chat with Copilot to learn installed add-on apps.

feature: Summarize with Copilot
description: Summarize with Copilot.

feature: Sales Order Agent to automate sales order-taking
description: Sales Order Agent to automate sales order-taking.

feature: Use autofill with Copilot to suggest field values
description: Suggests values for editable fields on card and document pages from company data or AI, letting users review and accept, discard, or replace suggestions. Update 26.4 adds web-based suggestions for publicly available contact details in sandbox environments when Bing Search is enabled.

feature: Post cash documents to projects in Czech localization
description: Lets users post cash-paid project expenses from cash documents by specifying the project and project task on the document line.

feature: Add more text in cash documents in Czech localization
description: Supports manual or automatic insertion of extended G/L account text into Czech cash documents.

feature: Use Peppol PINT A-NZ format for e-documents in AU and NZ
description: Supports PINT A-NZ e-invoices in the Australian and New Zealand e-document framework, with exchange through service providers, manual upload, or email.

feature: Use VAT Return to report VAT in local and functional currencies in Czech Republic
description: Shows VAT return amounts in both local and additional reporting currencies and produces files for submission under Czech requirements.

feature: Hide lines with zero quantity in Czech document reports
description: Adds an option to hide zero-quantity lines on selected Czech sales and purchase document reports.

feature: Define allowed languages per environment
description: Restricts the languages offered to users to those available through installed language apps, reducing the chance of selecting an unavailable translation.

feature: Troubleshoot clients, apps, and add-ins with telemetry
description: Emits client add-in exception telemetry with context such as environment, company, extension, client type, and error details to help administrators troubleshoot problems.

feature: Validate certificates on external web service endpoints called from AL HttpClient (controlled by **Feature Management**)
description: Validates server certificates for external HTTP endpoints called from AL HttpClient, with an application-level option to disable validation when needed.

feature: Use new properties on a report layout
description: Adds layout properties to mark a report layout obsolete and to control whether an Excel layout uses multiple data sheets.

feature: Embed Power BI content in web client with new page type
description: Introduces a streamlined page type for embedded Power BI reports with fewer irrelevant actions, improved spacing, and zoom and fit controls.

feature: Overloaded JsonObject data type GetValue method
description: Adds typed JsonObject access methods so AL code can read values directly without always handling a JsonToken.

feature: Move tables and fields with data across extensions as part of refactoring
description: Extends table and field moves with their data to partner extensions, supporting refactoring across apps.

feature: Extend CardPageId on list and listpart pages
description: Allows a page extension to override the card page opened from a list or list part, including when a user opens a selected record.

feature: Use the new continue keyword for AL loops
description: Adds a continue statement that skips the remainder of the current AL loop iteration and proceeds to the next one.

feature: Read and write YAML in AL using JsonObject
description: Adds methods for reading YAML into a JsonObject and writing a JsonObject as YAML, allowing AL code to manipulate YAML with existing JSON APIs.

feature: Mock outbound HttpClient web service calls during testing
description: Lets AL tests intercept outbound HttpClient requests and provide controlled responses, enabling isolated testing without calling the external service.

feature: View build metadata in Extension Management page
description: Displays extension build information in Extension Management so teams can trace an installed app to its build system and related development pipeline.

feature: Work with multiline strings in AL
description: Allows AL string literals to span multiple lines using the @ prefix, making structured text such as JSON templates easier to write and review.

feature: Receive project items with receipts or put-aways
description: Supports receiving project-related items directly from orders, inventory put-aways, or warehouse receipts, according to location configuration.

feature: Avoid document number errors when you post project journals
description: Adds a Renumber Document Numbers action to correct project journal lines whose document numbers do not follow the batch number series sequence.

feature: Combine service shipments on a single service invoice
description: Combines uninvoiced service shipments into invoices, including batch processing across multiple customers.

feature: Block items or variants from production output
description: Adds a Production Blocked setting on item and variant records to prevent selected items from being used as production output.

feature: Cancel production orders that have consumption
description: Provides a reverse production order transaction action for correcting posted consumption and capacity transactions when production orders must be cancelled or corrected.

feature: Reopen finished production orders
description: Allows a finished production order to be reopened to correct an error, subject to restrictions including a limit of one reopening.

feature: Enable overpicking for production orders
description: Allows eligible items to be overpicked on production warehouse picks after the item setting is enabled, with a process for returning excess items.

feature: Handle production output with warehouse put-aways
description: Supports creating warehouse put-aways for production output at suitably configured locations, including directed put-away and pick scenarios.

feature: Print barcodes from production orders
description: Adds a Print Label action to production orders for labels containing item information and 1D or 2D barcodes, with optional tracking identifiers.

feature: Create subscription contract lines manually
description: Lets users add subscription lines manually to a customer contract as a simple starting point for subscription billing.

feature: Add unit cost in subscription lines
description: Carries unit costs from subscription lines into billing proposals and documents, including actual supplier costs in usage scenarios.

feature: Track and rebill quantity changes in subscriptions
description: Detects quantity changes that require rebilling and marks affected subscription contract lines for consideration in the next billing cycle.

feature: Specify default sustainability values for various entities
description: Adds default sustainability accounts and emission values to selected business records so relevant sustainability data can be inherited during processes.

feature: Capture sustainability data with general journals
description: Lets users record emission amounts with financial transactions in a general journal and navigate to the resulting related sustainability entries.

feature: Enable sustainability Scope 3 value chain for assembly and transfers
description: Calculates CO2 equivalent values for transferred and assembled items using purchase-related emissions plus transfer or assembly emissions.

feature: Provide carbon equivalent data for sales based on Scope 3 automation
description: Shows calculated CO2 equivalent per unit and total CO2 equivalent as read-only values on sales document lines, based on sustainability value entries.

feature: Start value chain in purchase process for Scope 3 in sustainability
description: Creates sustainability ledger and value entries from emission values posted with purchase invoices, establishing a basis for Scope 3 tracking.

feature: Use sustainability Scope 3 value chain in manufacturing
description: Calculates finished-goods CO2 equivalent using raw-material emissions and manufacturing process emissions, with values exposed on production documents and journals.

feature: Preview PDF attachments directly in web client
description: Opens PDF attachments in an in-client preview without requiring a download, while retaining the option to download the file.

feature: Adjust the FactBox pane width
description: Lets users resize the FactBox pane within supported limits; the browser remembers the width for each user and page and can reset it by double-clicking the divider.

feature: Automate embedded attachments in PEPPOL
description: Automates embedding sales document PDFs in PEPPOL e-documents and processing embedded attachments in the purchase process.

feature: Generate multiple incoming e-documents for multiple attachments
description: Allows multiple files to be uploaded at once and creates incoming e-documents for files matching the selected service document format.

feature: Process e-documents in two steps
description: Offers a choice between automatic purchase document creation and a two-step process that requires explicit confirmation after the e-document is created.

feature: Extend E-Documents features using a new interface
description: Provides an extension interface for adding electronic-document capabilities and localization-specific processing to the e-document framework.

feature: Require Intrastat classifications on documents
description: Lets administrators require selected Intrastat fields on relevant EU purchase and sales documents before posting.

feature: Check total purchase amounts on documents
description: Makes purchase document total and VAT amount checks available globally to help validate invoices and credit memos before posting.

feature: Add support for MultiSubnetFailover
description: Adds a server setting that enables SQL Server MultiSubnetFailover on database connections to reduce failover time for supported availability configurations.

feature: Enhanced index troubleshooting
description: Provides missing-index information to help administrators and developers investigate database performance.

feature: Enhance reports with PDF post-processing capabilities
description: Adds AL capabilities to append PDFs, embed attachments, and set user or administrator passwords on report PDFs.

feature: Validate report layouts for errors as an admin
description: Adds a Validate Layout action that lets administrators inspect a report layout and receive a list of errors.

feature: Access report and request metadata in Word layouts
description: Exposes report object and request metadata, including company, user, and request time, to Word report layouts.

feature: Calculate values only for visible FlowFields (controlled by **Feature Management**)
description: Allows administrators to enable a runtime behavior that skips calculation of FlowFields hidden on a page, reducing unnecessary work.

feature: Use streamlined product design tools in manufacturing
description: Improves product design workflows with multi-item selection and Excel editing for supported production BOM and component lines.

feature: Achieve greater accuracy in manufacturing costing
description: Adds manufacturing-costing options including the ability to include noninventory item costs in the cost of produced items.

feature: Reschedule production orders within a safety lead time
description: Supports manual production scheduling with a configurable safety lead-time buffer between due and ending dates.

feature: Use ExFlow by SignUp connector for e-documents
description: Adds ExFlow by SignUp as an electronic document service integration option that customers can configure after consenting to the external service.

feature: Use Logiq as a service provider for e-documents
description: Adds Logiq as an electronic document service integration option with an assisted connection setup.

feature: Use the new Out of Scope emission category
description: Allows sustainability accounts and journals to record emissions under an Out of Scope classification in sustainability ledger entries.

feature: Use water and waste management with sustainability
description: Adds water and waste scopes to sustainability journals and ledger entries so organizations can record and report water and waste intensity.

feature: Optimize screen estate usage on the web (controlled by **Feature Management**)
description: Improves narrow-page and FactBox sizing and proportions in the web client to make better use of available screen space.

feature: Create e-documents from posted sales invoices
description: Lets users generate a missing e-document from a posted sales invoice when one was not created during posting; an existing related e-document prevents duplicate creation.

feature: Export reminders and finance charges as PEPPOL files
description: Supports creating PEPPOL-formatted e-documents from issued reminders and finance charge memos after the document types are enabled for the service.

feature: Automate tests for your Copilot extensions with the Business Central Test Toolkit
description: Provides a framework for authoring and organizing tests for Copilot prompt dialogs, including automated and semiautomated verification of responses.

feature: Delete incorrect e-documents and avoid duplicates
description: Checks for duplicate incoming electronic documents and allows administrators to delete eligible incorrect documents that are not already processed and linked to purchase documents.

feature: Preview incoming e-invoices prior to processing
description: Shows readable header and line information from an incoming electronic invoice or credit memo so users can review it before processing.

feature: Use e-documents to fix unposted purchase documents
description: Adds a Recreate Document action that rebuilds a deleted unposted purchase invoice or credit memo from the incoming e-document and its mappings.

feature: Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
description: Allows extension developers to use Business Central AI resources for Copilot features, reducing the need to manage a separate Azure OpenAI infrastructure.

feature: Use B2B Router as a service provider for E-documents
description: Adds B2BRouter as an e-document service integration option for electronic invoice exchange after the customer configures and consents to the external service.

feature: Use Continia as a service provider for e-documents
description: Adds Continia as a selectable e-document service provider and provides an onboarding action for the service connection.

feature: Analyze subscription billing data with Power BI reports
description: Provides a Power BI app for subscription billing analysis, including revenue, contract value, customer, item, and salesperson views.

feature: Add fields from related tables in analysis mode
description: Allows users to add fields from related tables as columns in an analysis-mode tab through its context menu.

feature: Use enhanced analytics for manufacturing (updated Power BI app)
description: Extends manufacturing analytics with Power BI reports for work-center and machine-center statistics and production-order costs.

feature: Use enhanced analytics for projects
description: Adds project planning analysis capabilities that make project data easier to explore in analysis mode.

feature: Use enhanced analytics for purchasing
description: Adds purchasing analysis capabilities, including a purchase-order performance query and improvements to selected pages and Excel reports.

feature: Use enhanced Excel reports for sustainability
description: Provides updated Excel layouts for sustainability reports, including emissions by category, emissions per facility, and total emissions, for printing and pivot analysis.

feature: Capture more sales with enhanced Sales Order Agent
description: The agent entered public preview in update 26.3 and reached general availability in 27.1. Update 26.4 added support for multiple ship-to addresses, alternatives when requested items cannot be delivered in time, and more options for agent administrators to guide autonomous processing.

feature: Chat with Copilot to learn how to use installed add-on apps
description: Allows users to ask Copilot questions about installed add-on apps using online documentation supplied by the apps; web-based information requires the administrator to enable Bing Search.

feature: Calculate and post VAT settlement by Activity Code - Italy
description: Allows separate VAT settlements for different activity codes in the same period and records the activity code in periodic VAT settlement entries.

feature: Use ZUGFeRD format for E-Documents in Germany
description: Supports the German ZUGFeRD hybrid electronic invoice format. Outbound sales invoices combine a PDF with an attached XML file; incoming invoices can have their XML extracted for e-document processing.

feature: Give more instructions for the agent when reviewing tasks
description: Give more instructions for the agent when reviewing tasks.

feature: Use Sales Order Agent to automate sales order-taking
description: Use Sales Order Agent to automate sales order-taking.

feature: Find pages and reports with advanced Tell Me search
description: Find pages and reports with advanced Tell Me search.

feature: Get more contextual invoice drafts with Payables Agent
description: Get more contextual invoice drafts with Payables Agent.

feature: Match purchase invoices to orders with Payables Agent
description: Match purchase invoices to orders with Payables Agent.

feature: Prioritize invoice draft changes with Payables Agent confidence level
description: Prioritize invoice draft changes with Payables Agent confidence level.

feature: Use Payables Agent in more countries and regions
description: Use Payables Agent in more countries and regions.

feature: Use enhanced chat with Copilot
description: Use enhanced chat with Copilot.

feature: Define sell-to and bill-to customer details per company location
description: Maps sell-to and bill-to customers for Shopify B2B orders using customer fields configured on each Shopify company location.

feature: Enable staff-to-salesperson mapping for Shopify orders
description: Maps Shopify staff members to Business Central salespeople so imported sales documents can populate the salesperson code.

feature: Synchronize market-specific prices with Shopify
description: Synchronizes prices for Shopify market catalogs using pricing settings such as customer price groups.

feature: Troubleshoot the Shopify Connector
description: Improves diagnostic information for issues such as refund processing and product creation, including error details and call stacks.

feature: Alternative posting groups for employees in Czechia
description: Changes employee posting-group reallocations in the Czech localization to use correction entries, avoiding artificial turnover increases in balancing accounts.

feature: Submit IRS 1099 forms electronically to IRIS in the US localization
description: Integrates with the IRS IRIS platform to submit US 1099 forms electronically through an API.

feature: Truncate table data with new AL method
description: Adds Rec.Truncate for efficient deletion of table data, with options related to supported tables and AutoIncrement values.

feature: View SQL call information in performance profiles
description: Includes SQL calls in supported sampling profiles so developers can distinguish AL execution costs from database activity.

feature: Set up the Clearance model in the E-Documents framework
description: Supports a clearance model in which a tax authority or authorized certifier preapproves electronic invoices before they are shared with customers.

feature: Use e-documents for shipment and transfer shipment document types
description: Adds outbound electronic document types for sales shipments and transfer shipments to support applicable regulatory requirements.

feature: Calculate excise taxes
description: Automates calculation of excise duties using product- and region-specific rules and rates. The initial release does not include statutory reporting.

feature: Create multiple fixed asset cards
description: Creates multiple fixed assets from purchase invoice processing to reduce manual work when a business acquires several similar assets.

feature: Use alternative posting groups for employees
description: Lets authorized users choose configured alternative employee posting groups instead of the default group when posting supported transactions.

feature: Tenant administrators can set Feature Management switches with an API
description: Exposes an API for tenant administrators to read and change Feature Management switches across companies or environments.

feature: Deferral reporting enhancements
description: Modernizes general ledger, sales, and purchasing deferral reports with Word and Excel layouts and related analysis tools.

feature: Enable projects with value chain automation in Scope 3
description: Collects project and project-task CO2 equivalent emissions from consumed items and resources using configured sustainability values.

feature: Enable taxonomy elements for ESRS and other standards
description: Aggregates Business Central transactional data using configurable sustainability taxonomies and can integrate it with external ESG reporting tools.

feature: Generate a CSRD preparation report
description: Creates a preparation report from configured sustainability taxonomies and aggregated transactional data for use in CSRD reporting work.

feature: Measure all gases as CO2 equivalents in Sustainability
description: Allows organizations to record emissions as carbon dioxide equivalents when values for individual gases are available only in CO2e form.

feature: Report on social and governance information for employees in Sustainability
description: Adds employee information such as engagement type, board membership, management role, and working hours for social and governance reporting.

feature: Require approvals for sustainability journals
description: Supports approval workflows and approval-request actions for standard and recurring sustainability journals.

feature: Track energy consumption in Sustainability
description: Records energy consumption by source in sustainability journals and purchase invoices, and posts the data to sustainability ledger entries for reporting.

feature: Track item charges across value chain automation in Scope 3
description: Includes emissions associated with item charges in the sustainability value chain and related entries.

feature: Track items of concern related to gas emissions
description: Flags items of environmental concern and requires an emission value so they can be monitored and reported.

feature: Use ESG Reporting integrated with Business Central
description: Connects collected sustainability data with ESG reporting workflows and regulatory taxonomies.

feature: Adjust width of Copilot, help, and page scripting panes
description: Lets users resize these side panes, remembers the chosen widths, and restores default width when the divider is double-clicked.

feature: Use the Concealed text field type for sensitive data
description: Adds the AL MaskType property for text fields so values are hidden by default and displayed when a user chooses the reveal control.

feature: Give more instructions for the agent when you review its tasks
description: Lets users provide additional instructions in the agent task pane to resolve blockers, such as a missing customer or item, and allow the agent to continue.

feature: Understand how each Copilot and agent capability is billed
description: Adds a Billing Type column that identifies whether a capability is billed by Microsoft, billed by a partner, or not consumption-billed.

feature: Use enhanced analysis assist with Copilot
description: Adds analysis-assist enhancements including access permissions, related-table fields, and feedback about design choices that can affect performance.

feature: Use the Admin permission set with e-documents
description: Introduces an E-Documents Admin permission set for users who manage electronic document services and related setup.

feature: Use the E-Documents framework with Power Automate and other solutions
description: Provides APIs for integrations to exchange e-document files through Power Automate and other systems, including automated receipt scenarios.

feature: Access open-sourced Power BI apps
description: Makes the source for Business Central Power BI apps available so organizations can adapt their semantic models and reports.

feature: Add data fields to report layouts using Word add-in
description: Lets report authors insert dataset items, repeaters, and fields from a Word add-in task pane as an alternative to the XML Mapping pane.

feature: Use drill-back and dynamic dimension names in Power BI apps
description: Adds drill-back from Power BI to underlying Business Central details and supports dynamic dimension names in Power BI apps.

feature: Add more fields and columns by personalizing pages
description: Makes additional fields, such as Statistics Group and selected posting or price settings, available through page personalization.

feature: Sort lines by type and number in sales and purchase postings
description: Changes line-processing order when concurrent inventory posting is enabled so sessions lock resources in a consistent order and are less likely to deadlock.

feature: Set up Service Participants to Company Information
description: Extends company information with service-participant identifiers so electronic document exchange can identify receiving companies using appropriate schemes.

feature: External storage support for document attachments
description: Stores document attachments in a connected external service such as Azure or SharePoint while allowing users to access them from Business Central, helping reduce database storage usage.

feature: Stop all active tasks for selected agent
description: Adds a confirmed action to stop all currently active tasks for a selected agent, useful when it is overloaded or misconfigured.

feature: Link inbound e-documents to purchase invoices
description: Lets users link an inbound e-document to an existing purchase invoice or credit memo, matching candidates using information such as vendor and total amount.

feature: Set a default e-document type on vendor templates
description: Adds a default e-document type to vendor templates so newly created vendors inherit either purchase order or purchase invoice processing.

feature: Use self-billed invoices
description: Supports buyer-created purchase invoices under a self-billing agreement, with a vendor setting and dedicated number series for self-billed documents.

feature: Migrate to the cloud from any SQL database
description: Extends cloud migration tooling with a generic custom migration type so developers can build reusable migration extensions for SQL-based source systems.

feature: Set default language for documents on the company level
description: Introduces a company default language for documents to reduce unintended language choices caused by the individual user's interface language.

feature: Add pictures to item variants to differentiate product options
description: Adds a picture FactBox to item variant cards so users can import, capture, export, or remove an image representing a variant.

feature: Approve requisition worksheets and item journals
description: Extends approval workflows to item journal batches and requisition or planning worksheets so entries can be reviewed before posting or creating purchase documents.

feature: Create purchase quotes for contacts
description: Lets users create purchase quotes for contacts before a vendor exists and use a vendor template when converting or releasing the document.

feature: Define item attributes for item variants
description: Allows item variants to inherit item attributes and adjust their attribute values to represent differences such as color or size.

feature: Evaluate the quality of goods and materials
description: Provides a Quality Management extension for planning and carrying out checks on processes such as purchase receipts and production output.

feature: Transfer journal line descriptions to bank statements
description: Adds a Keep Description setting for bank-account journal processing so relevant payment journal line descriptions can be retained when bank statements are created.

feature: Assign custom collections to items exported to Shopify
description: Imports Shopify custom product collections and lets users assign exported items to them; rule-based Smart collections are outside this feature.

feature: Export items to Shopify with product options based on item attributes
description: Maps up to three Business Central item attributes to Shopify product options, such as color or size, during product synchronization.

feature: Sync images of product variants between Business Central and Shopify
description: Synchronizes images between Business Central item variants and the corresponding Shopify product variants.

feature: Use checkout currency when you create sales documents from Shopify orders
description: Lets a shop choose whether imported sales documents use the shop currency or the customer's checkout currency.

feature: Connect AI agents to the admin center through MCP server
description: Introduces a preview MCP server for Business Central admin center APIs, allowing compatible agents to discover administrative operations and retrieve environment information.

feature: Manage database index usage and cost per company
description: Lets administrators inspect and selectively disable eligible indexes by company to balance write performance and storage; protected unique and primary indexes cannot be disabled.

feature: Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
description: Provides read-only APIs for approval workflows, user mappings, and action history to support external security and audit analysis.

feature: Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff
description: Provides read-only permission-system APIs for analyzing permission sets, objects, security-group mappings, and user assignments.

feature: Add the Description 2 field to various pages to gain more insight
description: Makes Description 2 available for personalization on additional pages, including production BOM, routing, and planning component pages.

feature: Create purchase orders from drop shipments
